summary: A set of tabs bundled together and labeled as a group, so they can be collapsed or moved as one.
description: A named, colorable, collapsible container that groups related tabs (and split-view wrappers) together in the tabstrip. A classic XUL custom element with a static light-DOM template (label + overflow-count areas) and no shadow root.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The group's display name; setter falls back to a zero-width space so layout stays stable, updates aria/tooltip, and fires TabGroupUpdate on change. Aliased as "name".
attributes.default: \u200b (zero-width space, used when label is empty)

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Whether the group's tabs are collapsed/hidden; setter unlocks tab widths, updates aria/tooltip/overflow, and fires TabGroupCollapse/TabGroupExpand.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Not attribute-backed: the setter writes six CSS custom properties (--tab-group-color, -color-invert, -color-pale, -background-color, -background-color-hover, -text-color, -text-color-invert) pointing at the matching palette token set. Valid values: blue, cyan, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, yellow.

attributes.name: hasactivetab
attributes.description: Reflects whether one of the group's member tabs is currently active; updated in response to TabSelect/SplitViewTabChange.

attributes.name: movingtabgroup
attributes.description: Internal drag/drop coordination flag, backed by the isBeingDragged getter/setter.

attributes.name: previewpanelactive
attributes.description: Internal flag for the hover-preview panel, gated behind the browser.tabs.groups.hoverPreview.enabled pref.

attributes.name: hasmultipletabs
attributes.description: Internal CSS hook toggled by #updateOverflowLabel() to control overflow-count display.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Real children (tab and tab-split-view-wrapper elements) are always inserted, via an overridden appendChild, immediately before the overflow-count container, giving DOM order [label-container, ...tabs/split-views..., overflow-count-container]. There is no shadow root, so the <html:slot/> in the static markup is a positional placeholder only, not a functioning slot.

events.name: TabGroupCreate
events.description: Fired once in connectedCallback on first mount; detail: {isAdoptingGroup} when created via adoption.

events.name: TabGroupUpdate
events.description: Fired from the color and label setters whenever the value actually changes.

events.name: TabGroupRemoved
events.description: Fired by a mutation observer when the group's tab count hits 0, just before the group removes itself.

events.name: TabGroupCollapse
events.description: Fired from the collapsed setter when collapsing.

events.name: TabGroupExpand
events.description: Fired from the collapsed setter when expanding.

events.name: TabGroupAnimationComplete
events.description: Fired after all pending member-tab width-transition animations settle following a collapse/expand.

events.name: TabGroupUngroup
events.description: Fired at the start of ungroupTabs(); detail: {metricsContext}.

events.name: TabGroupSaved
events.description: Fired in save() after the group is added to SessionStore as a saved tab group; detail: {metricsContext}.

events.name: TabGroupLabelHoverStart
events.description: Dispatched on the internal label element (not the host) on mouseover.

events.name: TabGroupLabelHoverEnd
events.description: Dispatched on the internal label element (not the host) on mouseout.

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-label-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the group label.

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-label-highlight-thickness
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the label's hover/active highlight.

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-label-highlight-radius
cssProperties.description: Border radius of the label's hover/active highlight (horizontal tabstrip; 4px for vertical).

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-label-hover-inset
cssProperties.description: Inset of the label hover highlight (vertical tabstrip only).

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-line-thickness
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the colored context line under grouped tabs.

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-line-toolbar-border-distance
cssProperties.description: Distance of the context line from the toolbar border.

cssProperties.name: --tab-group-{color}
cssProperties.description: Per-color palette base token; color is one of blue, cyan, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, yellow.

cssProperties.name: --dragover-tab-group-color
cssProperties.description: Drag-feedback color, set by drag-and-drop.js and consumed in tabs.css.
